newsitem.title: MEXICO: Spain's king arrives in Mexico.
newsitem.headline: Spain's king arrives in Mexico.

text.p: King of Spain Juan Carlos arrived in Mexico on Thursday at the start of a five-day state visit to Spain's one-time colony.
Juan Carlos and his wife Sofia were greeted at a Mexico City airport by Mexico's Foreign Affairs Minister, Jose Angel Gurria.
Mexico City streets were bordered with banners splashed with the colours of Spain's flag, while photos of the king and queen were plastered on bus stops beneath a welcome sign.
The king, in his third visit to what was once called New Spain, will meet with Mexican President Ernesto Zedillo on Friday.
He will also meet with business leaders, and attend a high-level congress on the Spanish language in the city of Zacatecas before leaving for New York next Monday.
Spanish journalists accompanying the king and queen were more interested in rumours that the king's daughter Cristina is planning to marry soccer player Inaki Urdangarin.
"The royal family does not comment on rumours. There is no news," said their spokesman, Asuncion Valdes.
